- Overestimate prices after recent spikes or positive sentiment; model tends to overshoot in bullish phases.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is negative or trending downward; model reacts too slowly to bearish signals.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias: overcorrects after sharp moves, leading to premature reversal in price direction.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag in capturing short-term sentiment shifts; adjust for sentiment momentum lag (e.g., 2–3 days).
- When sentiment is neutral or mildly positive, model often overweights recent highs; reduce forecast peak values in such cases.
- Avoid extrapolating recent trends when sentiment is volatile; use sentiment smoothing or weighted average for transitional periods.
- If sentiment turns negative within 3–5 days, reduce forecast slope and introduce downward bias to avoid overconfidence in continuation.
